meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 收到发布请求后,Claude 会触发自动化发布流程,先确认或询问版本类型,再起草公告,最后核对 npm 与 GitHub 上的新版本并向 Discord 发公告。流程中不会审查或修改代码,除非你明确要求。
howto.when: 当对话里出现 “publish”“release”“deploy” 等发布词,或你要求发布/部署项目时触发。它必须有版本类型(patch、minor、major 或具体版本号),没有就先问你。

say.text: 把 oh-my-opencode 以 patch 版本发布到 npm。
say.note: 触发完整发布流程并核对结果。

say.text: 用 minor 版本发布,并在 Discord 发公告。
say.note: 公告会在版本说明完成后发出。
直接按指定版本号发布。

howto.what_en: On publish requests, Claude runs the whole release: triggers the automation, drafts the notes, checks that the new package is live on npm and GitHub, then notifies Discord. It won't review or change code unless asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions publish, release, deploy, or similar and asks to ship the project. It stops and asks until a version selector (patch, minor, major, or explicit semver) is provided.

say_en.text: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm as a patch release.
say_en.note: Starts the full workflow and verifies the result.

say_en.text: Cut a minor release and announce it on Discord.
say_en.note: Posts the announcement after release notes are finalized.
Uses the explicit semver instead of a bump type.
